content.comment_body: Hello, We purchased some [product_name] modules to access from our LAN network, replacing our older ones. We also want to install the latest available software (we downloaded the demo version). However, we cannot connect any of the modules to a computer directly or through a network switch. We would appreciate advice on how to make them work and test with the demo.

You can't establish communication with a [product_name] using the demo version. This is only possible once you have the full version installed. The demo version only allows you to create, modify, and test programs in simulation mode.

Hello [user_name], Which device do you have specifically? (Please provide the [article_no].) With the demo program, you cannot transfer or read data from the device, nor monitor the program online. For that, you need the full version, which can be purchased. If you already have an older full version, it is possible to download an upgrade to the latest version for free after registration. Regards [user_name]
Refer to the topic title. [product_name] [article_no] does not communicate over LAN.

Hello, We purchased some [product_name] modules to access via the LAN network, replacing our older ones. We also downloaded the newest demo software. However, we cannot connect any modules to a computer directly or through a network switch. Advice on getting them to work and test with the demo would be appreciated.
Have you read my previous answer here? WITH THE DEMO VERSION YOU CANNOT COMMUNICATE WITH A REAL [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users attempting to connect [product_name] modules to a LAN network encountered issues communicating when using the demo version of the associated software. Responses clarify that demo software does not offer programming or online diagnostic capabilities with actual devices and limits functionality to simulation only. This restriction affects the initial experience for users evaluating or replacing hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hoped to connect [product_name] modules to a computer or network in order to perform programming and diagnostics using the demo software before deciding to purchase the full version.
